libs.note: BH-8848. vs_publish, the one writer of the lead-verdict, prequeue-verdict and landing-path commit statuses. Read through lib_env_apply verdict-status in _vs_retry_max, only when a status POST got a rate-limit 403/429 with a Retry-After header.

knobs.note: The longest Retry-After, in seconds, that vs_publish waits before it sends a rate-limited status POST once more. A longer Retry-After is not retried. 0 = never retry. A value that is not a whole number uses 30.
